correctness.rationale: Reflection splits the weighted cycle into fixed even modes and an irreducible odd Jacobi block; for positive nonunit weight no cross-parity spectral coincidence. Even-mode zeros give a precise gcd obstruction. An odd-mode nodal zero forces a tail eigenangle 2pi*k/(n-2j-1) and a positive sine-ratio endpoint weight, and each such value constructs an eigenvector. At half weight on odd rings the antisymmetric block becomes exactly Dirichlet Toeplitz, giving gcd rank deficiency and labelled totient count. Reconstructed boundary quantifiers and verified 550 exact rational finite Kalman ranks plus 13 totient instances; finite checks do not prove universal results.
